# MCP tools: Shopping

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.mcp.export_tool_reference` from `contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

[MCP tool reference](index.md) | 8 model-visible tools. The tools of this area that only the MCP App rooms call are on the [app-only page](app-only.md).

## `list_shopping_lists`

List owned shopping lists, bounded and paginated.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `shopping:read`.

Returns: `ListsResult` with `lists` (array of ListSummary), `next_offset` (integer or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `include_archived` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `50`; 1 to 100 |
| `offset` | integer | no | default `0`; 0 to 10000 |

## `get_shopping_list`

Read one owned shopping list and open its interactive app.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `shopping:read`.

Returns: `ListDetail` with `evaluated_on` (date), `items` (array of ItemRecord), `next_offset` (integer or null), `shopping_list` (ListRecord), `store` (string or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `list_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `100`; 1 to 100 |
| `offset` | integer | no | default `0`; 0 to 10000 |
| `on_date` | date | no | ISO 8601 date; may be null |
| `store` | string | no | up to 200 characters; may be null |

## `create_shopping_list`

On the user's explicit request, create one named shopping list.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `shopping:read`, `shopping:write`.

Returns: `ListResult` with `shopping_list` (ListRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `name` | string | yes | 1 to 200 characters |

## `update_shopping_list`

Explicitly rename, archive or restore one owned list using its current version.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `shopping:read`, `shopping:write`.

Returns: `ListResult` with `shopping_list` (ListRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `archived` | boolean | yes | - |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `list_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `name` | string | yes | 1 to 200 characters |
| `version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |

## `add_shopping_items`

Commit 1-50 user-reviewed items atomically to one owned active list; on failure none are added.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `shopping:read`, `shopping:write`.

Returns: `BatchResult` with `evaluated_on` (date), `items` (array of AddedItem), `list_name` (string), `merged_count` (integer), `open_count` (integer or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `items` | array of object | yes | 1 to 50 items |
| `items[].client_ref` | string | yes | 1 to 64 characters; pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$` |
| `items[].name` | string | yes | 1 to 200 characters |
| `items[].note` | string | no | up to 2000 characters; may be null |
| `items[].occasion` | string | no | up to 200 characters; may be null |
| `items[].offer` | object | no | may be null |
| `items[].offer.checked_on` | date | yes | ISO 8601 date |
| `items[].offer.price` | number or string | yes | above 0.0; up to 99999999.99; pattern `^(?!^[-+.]*$)[+-]?0*(?:\d{0,8}\|(?=[\d.]{1,11}0*$)\d{0,8}\.\d{0,2}0*$)` |
| `items[].offer.source` | string | yes | 1 to 200 characters |
| `items[].offer.valid_from` | date | yes | ISO 8601 date |
| `items[].offer.valid_until` | date | yes | ISO 8601 date |
| `items[].offer.currency` | string | no | default `"SEK"`; pattern `^[A-Z]{3}$` |
| `items[].offer.regular_price` | number or string | no | above 0.0; up to 99999999.99; pattern `^(?!^[-+.]*$)[+-]?0*(?:\d{0,8}\|(?=[\d.]{1,11}0*$)\d{0,8}\.\d{0,2}0*$)`; may be null |
| `items[].offer.source_url` | string | no | up to 2000 characters; may be null |
| `items[].product_url` | string | no | up to 2000 characters; may be null |
| `items[].quantity` | number or string | no | default `"1"`; above 0.0; up to 999999.999; pattern `^(?!^[-+.]*$)[+-]?0*(?:\d{0,6}\|(?=[\d.]{1,10}0*$)\d{0,6}\.\d{0,3}0*$)` |
| `items[].recipient_contact_id` | uuid | no | may be null |
| `items[].store` | string | no | up to 200 characters; may be null |
| `items[].target_date` | date | no | ISO 8601 date; may be null |
| `items[].unit` | string | no | up to 30 characters; may be null |
| `list_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `merge_duplicates` | boolean | no | default `false` |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.

| `item.occasion` | string | no | up to 200 characters; may be null |

| `item.offer.valid_from` | date | yes | ISO 8601 date |
| `item.offer.valid_until` | date | yes | ISO 8601 date |
| `item.offer.currency` | string | no | default `"SEK"`; pattern `^[A-Z]{3}$` |

| `item.offer.source_url` | string | no | up to 2000 characters; may be null |

| `item.quantity` | number or string | no | default `"1"`; above 0.0; up to 999999.999; pattern `^(?!^[-+.]*$)[+-]?0*(?:\d{0,6}\|(?=[\d.]{1,10}0*$)\d{0,6}\.\d{0,3}0*$)` |

## `set_shopping_item_purchased`

Explicitly mark one owned shopping item purchased or wanted again, with version checking and append-only history.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `shopping:read`, `shopping:write`.

Returns: `ItemResult` with `evaluated_on` (date), `item` (ItemRecord), `list_name` (string), `open_count` (integer or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `item_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `purchased` | boolean | yes | - |
| `version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |

## `set_shopping_items_purchased`

Explicitly mark 1-50 owned shopping items purchased or wanted again in one atomic call, for example everything bought in a shop.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `shopping:read`, `shopping:write`.

Returns: `PurchasedBatchResult` with `evaluated_on` (date), `items` (array of ItemRecord), `open_count` (integer or null), `unchanged_item_ids` (array of uuid).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `items` | array of object | yes | 1 to 50 items |
| `items[].item_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `items[].version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |
| `purchased` | boolean | yes | - |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.
